note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. A and B are two configured states of the same example with equal visual weight (solid ● and ◆ badges); 'Draft, not filed' is not a defect or penalty. Nothing states a filing rule, fee, court, admissibility, deadline or any effect of registering or not filing.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: A: the fictional filing is handed in, stamped with Ref. REG-0417 (fictional) and entered on Day 2 (as supplied). B: the same signed filing is kept by Party A as a draft; its reference box stays blank. A guide outlines both reference boxes.
